sources.label: 令和8年6月定例会（第2回） 議案一覧

name: 長期収載品の選定療養費の算定割合を変更
summary: 町田市民病院では、後発医薬品がある長期収載品を選んだ場合の選定療養費を、薬価の差額の4分の1をもとに算定しています。この議案で、算定に使う割合を2分の1にし、2026年7月1日以後の使用分に適用します。
changes: 薬価差額に掛ける割合を4分の1から2分の1に変える
who: 町田市民病院で、後発医薬品のある長期収載品を選ぶ患者

en.name: Changes the calculation rate for the fee for choosing long-listed medicines
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Use of Machida Municipal Hospital
en.summary: At Machida Municipal Hospital, when a patient chooses a long-listed medicine for which a generic medicine is available, the fee for choosing that medicine is calculated based on one quarter of the difference in drug prices. This bill changes the rate used in the calculation to one half. The change applies to medicines used on or after July 1, 2026.
changes: Changes the rate applied to the difference in drug prices from one quarter to one half
who: Patients at Machida Municipal Hospital who choose a long-listed medicine for which a generic medicine is available
